rationale: Switch from fluoxetine to escitalopram for tolerability or response reasons. Brief overlap is sufficient because norfluoxetine continues to circulate for 1-2 weeks after fluoxetine is discontinued, providing serotonergic bridge while escitalopram titrates up. Start escitalopram low to avoid additive load. PENDING_CLINICAL_REVIEW.

schedule.notes: Start escitalopram 5 mg. Hold fluoxetine 20 mg.
Stop fluoxetine. Norfluoxetine continues for 1-2 weeks — explain the invisible bridge to the patient.

doseRatios.equivalencyNote: Approximate clinical equivalency: fluoxetine 20 mg ≈ escitalopram 10 mg (Maudsley 14th). Slow escitalopram titration is intentional given norfluoxetine carry-over. PENDING_CLINICAL_REVIEW.
